Sinalização; Alimentação elétrica; Rede aérea de contato; AFC; Monitoramento integrado; Material rodante; Veículos de engenharia; Equipamentos depátio/oficina. -Participar da inspeção da qualidade de materiais, componentes pré-fabricados e equipamentos entregues ao local da obra;realizar controle rigoroso dos principais pontos de controle da qualidade dos processos;executar inspeções de qualidade regulares e extraordinárias no local;participar da gestão daqualidade durante o comissionamento, recebimento definitivo e demais fases do projeto. -Garantir o cumprimento das disposições estabelecidas nas Regras de Implementação da Gestão da Qualidade do Projeto, aplicando mecanismos de gestão da qualidade. -Emitir solicitações de correção quando forem identificados problemas de qualidade ou potenciais riscos;acompanhar e verificar a conclusão das ações corretivas;participar da investigação, análise e tratamento de acidentes de qualidade;realizar avaliações periódicas dos riscos de qualidade e apresentar relatórios sobre a situação dos riscos. -Realizar comunicação e coordenação sobre qualidade com o Cliente, Engenheiro de Supervisão, subcontratados e autoridades regulatórias brasileiras;realizar auditorias internas de qualidade;coordenar auditorias externas de qualidade organizadas pelo Cliente e por instituições terceirizadas, acompanhando o encerramento completo das ações corretivas. - Administrar os documentos de qualidade do projeto e os arquivos relacionados ao recebimento e conclusão da obra, garantindo que toda a documentação de qualidade esteja em conformidade com as regulamentações brasileiras, cláusulas contratuais e requisitos estabelecidos pelo Cliente, equipe de supervisão e demais partes envolvidas, assegurando documentação completa e rastreável para a entrega do projeto. Requisitos: -Formação superior em Gestão da Qualidade, Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Automação, Gestão de Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; -Experiência em gestão da qualidade em projetos de engenharia; -Experiência prática com controle de qualidade em campo; -Domínio das normas ISO 9001; -Conhecimento da ISO 22163 (IRIS) será importante para a posição; -Inglês para leitura e escrita de documentos técnicos; Habilidades Comportamentais: -Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e coordenação; -Consciência e capacidade de atuação em equipes multiculturais; -

title: International bookkeeper & finance specialist (remote - brazil)
description:
Empresa está contratando International bookkeeper & finance specialist (remote - brazil) em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)Position Type:Full-Time or Part-Time Contract Location:Remote (Must be based in Brazil) Reports To:CRO / Founder Language Requirement:Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)We are a growing digital business with an establishedUS LLCand a expanding presence inBrazil(including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilledInternational Bookkeeper & Finance Specialistto manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities. In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.Key Responsibilities: 1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., Quick Books Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Trackintercompany transactions(capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office). 2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese. 3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements: Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure). 4. Data Integrity & Reporting: Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership. Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory):3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency:Flawless written and spokenEnglish(for US vendors/clients) andPortuguese(for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency:Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (Quick Books, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge:Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks. What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

title: Analista de revenue operations - revops
description:

Não queremos alguém que apenas ajuste processo e limpe base: queremos quem identifica gargalos, propõe e constrói soluções — dashboards, automações, agentes de IA, rotinas de roteamento e scoring — que viram alavanca real de resultado para vendas e marketing. Estamos dispostos a treinar quem vier com a mentalidade certa. O que não negociamos: raciocínio analítico, organização, proatividade e vontade de aplicar IA de verdade numa operação em crescimento acelerado. Sobre a Empresa Nossa Missão Acelerar o Brasil com Inteligência Artificial Nossa Visão Acelerar 10 mil empresas com IA até 2030 Nossos Valores Lealdade Construímos relações de longo prazo — com clientes, colegas e parceiros. Postura de Dono Agimos como donos do negócio, com responsabilidade e protagonismo. Diversão e Desafio Acreditamos que crescer e se divertir não são opostos. Investimento em Crescimento Evoluímos as pessoas que escolhem crescer conosco.⚡ Agilidade 80/20 Focamos no que gera mais resultado com menos desperdício.✨ Encantamento Superamos expectativas — de clientes, candidatos e time. Responsabilidades & Entregas Integração Marketing + Vendas Unificar a leitura do funil ponta a ponta — da origem da mídia ao contrato fechado — com definições de estágio, nomenclatura e critérios de qualificação compartilhados entre os times. Garantir rastreabilidade completa de origem do lead (UTMs, campanhas, canais) até a receita, para que marketing saiba o que gera venda e vendas saiba o que está recebendo. Operar o SLA entre marketing e vendas: volume e qualidade de MQLs, tempo de resposta, taxa de aceite e devolução de leads. Ser o ponto neutro na mesa quando os times divergem sobre qualidade de lead ou performance — trazendo dado, não opinião. Dados, Visibilidade e Decisão Construir e manter os dashboards de receita da operação — funil, conversão por etapa, CAC, ciclo de vendas, forecast e performance individual. Garantir a integridade dos dados no CRM: higienização, deduplicação, regras de preenchimento obrigatório e auditoria recorrente. Transformar dado em recomendação: identificar gargalos, quantificar o impacto e levar à liderança o que precisa ser decidido — com hipótese e plano de ação. Preparar os números das rituais da operação: reunião de forecast, passada de receita e reportes para a diretoria. Construção de Alavancas Projetar e implementar automações que eliminem trabalho manual do time comercial e de marketing — roteamento de leads, cadências, notificações, atualizações de CRM e handoffs entre áreas. Criar e evoluir soluções aplicadas de IA para a operação: qualificação assistida, scoring de leads, sumarização de calls, enriquecimento de base e apoio à priorização de pipeline. Prototipar rápido, medir o resultado e decidir com clareza o que escala e o que é descartado — sem se apegar à própria construção. Documentar processos e treinar os times nas ferramentas e rotinas criadas, garantindo adoção real e não só entrega técnica. O Que Esperamos de VocêRequisitos2 a 5 anos de experiência em Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, BI ou growth com foco em receita. Domínio de ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Metabase, Looker Studio, Power BI ou equivalentes) — capaz de construir dashboard do zero, não apenas consumir. Experiência prática com ferramentas de automação low-code (n8n, Make, Zapier) — construindo fluxos que rodam em produção. Vivência como administrador de CRM (Pipedrive, Hub Spot, Clint ou similar): campos, funis, permissões, integrações e relatórios. Entendimento do funil comercial B2 B completo: geração de demanda, pré-vendas, closing e pós-venda. Diferenciais Valorizados SQL para consultas em base própria. Experiência construindo agentes ou fluxos com IA generativa aplicados a operação comercial. Vivência em Edtech, infoproduto ou operação de vendas de alto volume. Passagem por startup em hypergrowth, onde o processo foi construído e não herdado. Perfil Comportamental Tem postura de dono — não espera briefing pronto;enxerga o problema, formula a hipótese e traz a solução.É builder por natureza: fica incomodado com trabalho manual repetitivo e resolve construindo, não reclamando. Pensa em negócio antes de pensar em ferramenta — entende que dashboard bonito sem decisão tomada é desperdício. Transita bem entre marketing e vendas sem tomar partido;

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ai agent engineer em porto alegre. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About First IgniteFirst Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.The role We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse. The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a person reviews before anything happens with it. Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision, traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.What you'll do • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling, included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud. • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation. • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch. • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses. Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task. • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate. • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable. Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both. • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as regression tests. • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality. • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy. • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to you.Required Qualifications: • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real users touched. • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about a multi-step run. • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and turned them into something an agent can call reliably. • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against a structured source of truth. • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included. • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and what to do about it. • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question being asked instead of a nearby one. • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval for them. • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust. • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the furthest east we can go. You might currently be titled AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll go on what you've shipped.Preferred Qualifications: • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking. • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong. • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance. • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences. • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

description:

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. title: Professor de espanhol

Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.Sobre a Oportunidade:A EIT Caldeiraria Ltda atua na fabricação e execução de soluções em caldeiraria industrial, atendendo demandas de produção e montagem com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e atendimento às necessidades operacionais dos clientes. Com forte interface entre engenharia e chão de fábrica, a empresa busca evoluir sua gestão produtiva para ganhar previsibilidade, produtividade e competitividade. title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior ai agent engineer em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About First IgniteFirst Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.The role We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse. The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a person reviews before anything happens with it. Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision, traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.What you'll do • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling, included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud. • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation. • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch. • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses. Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task. • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate. • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable. Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both. • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as regression tests. • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality. • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy. • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to you.Required Qualifications: • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real users touched. • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about a multi-step run. • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and turned them into something an agent can call reliably. • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against a structured source of truth. • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included. • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and what to do about it. • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question being asked instead of a nearby one. • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval for them. • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust. • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the furthest east we can go. You might currently be titled AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll go on what you've shipped.Preferred Qualifications: • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking. • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong. • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance. • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences. • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

description:

Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open FinanceType: Full-TimeLanguage: EnglishLocation: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)Reports to: Head of designThe CompanyNova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.Its first product is a B2 C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit cardlimits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.The RoleWe are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We're looking for an outstanding product designer who will:• Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product.• Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.• Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.• Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision• Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.• Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.• Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.• Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.• Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.The QualificationsRequired:• 7+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.• Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.• Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).• Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.• Full professional proficiency in EnglishPreferred:• Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.• Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.• Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.• Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).The Target CompaniesCandidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:• Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora...• Strong Local Digital Product Companies: Quinto Andar, i Food, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo...• Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song...• Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft• Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), PinterestThe Selection ProcessMaterials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the processPortfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.The Offer Package• Model: PJ• Compensation: aggressive salary• Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants• Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and WellhubIf you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

Por todo o mundo, e por muitas plantas e setores, nossas equipes multifuncionais estão trabalhando proativamente para otimizar o potencial de nosso sistema de manufatura. Atuando de maneira dinâmica, ágil e focada na satisfação do consumidor, as equipes de Manufatura contribuem para garantir que a Electrolux continue na vanguarda da inovação em produtos e serviços.    O que você vai fazer:    Atuando como Operador/a de Manufatura, você vai ser responsável pela operação de equipamentos e dispositivos específicos na fábrica de Curitiba, lidando com processos de fabricação, inspeção e movimento de materiais, entre outros. Onde você vai estar:    Você vai atuar em uma das plantas da Electrolux em Curitiba que funcionam como base para equipes de produção completamente focadas em transformar a vida para o melhor através da excelência no trabalho.    Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:   - Descontos nos produtos e serviços da Electrolux;   - Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;   - Participação nos lucros anuais;   - Licença parental estendida (6 meses de licença maternidade, 4 semanas de licença paternidade);   - Acesso ao Wellhub (Gympass);   - Amplas oportunidades de aprendizado e flexibilidade de carreira. title: 3d character animator
description:
Nova oportunidade para 3d character animator em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

3 D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter I'm looking to hire an experienced 3 D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life. The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation, with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay. What I'm Looking For Required Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3 D character animation Ideally 5–10+ years of 3 D animation experience Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects Excellent understanding of: Combat animation Body mechanics Weight and momentum Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game Strongly Preferred Cascadeur Blender Unity Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity Bonus Skills I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3 D character pipeline, including: Retopology (for minor clean-up work)UV unwrapping Texturing Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)Weight painting Character and animal animation Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority. If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you. The Project This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone. Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material. Who Would Be a Great Fit I'm looking for someone who: Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly Has experience with small or independent game-development teams Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

Requisitos Graduação em Direito com inscrição ativa na OAB; Experiência comprovada em Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital e LGPD; Vivência na implementação de programas de privacidade e governança de dados; Experiência em elaboração e negociação de contratos envolvendo tratamento de dados pessoais; Conhecimento emgestão de riscos, Compliance Corporativo e governança; Excelente capacidade de redação jurídica e comunicação com clientes; Perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado à solução de problemas. Diferenciais Pós-graduação ou especialização em Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital, Compliance ou áreas correlatas; Certificações reconhecidas na área (EXIN Privacy & Data Protection, IAPP, CIPM, CIPP/E, CDPO, ISO 27701, ISO 27001 ou equivalentes); Experiência atuando como DPO interno ou externo; Conhecimento em Segurança da Informação, Governança Corporativa e Gestão de Riscos; Inglês intermediário ou avançado; Produção de conteúdo técnico (artigos, palestras, cursos ou publicações); Participação ativa em eventos, associações e comunidades de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados; Presença profissional consolidada no Linked In e boa rede de relacionamento no mercado. O perfil que buscamos Mais do que conhecimento jurídico, buscamos um profissional que seja referência técnica, tenha visão estratégica de negócios, saiba construir relacionamento com clientes e queira participar do desenvolvimento de uma prática jurídica moderna, consultiva e altamente especializada.
